notes: Provenance unification model · founder-authorised design 2026-09-12. Every measurable claim any future NEX component makes MUST be walkable backwards to source. No orphan measurements. No anonymous numbers.
founder_rule: NEX2 claim → Evidence ID → measurement → source_hash → tool + version → methodology → reproducibility → actual source. Any missing link = chain broken = claim unsupported.

chain_step_kinds.definition: the top-level assertion (e.g. NEX2 claim · NEX3 verdict criterion · Standards Feed rule reference)
the EvidenceRecord id or CodeHealth metric_id that the claim cites
the actual measurement · dimension · value · state
the sha256_prefix of the observed source
the tool that produced the measurement · with version
how the tool was invoked · deterministic method description

chain_integrity_rules: every step MUST reference the next by ID · never a free-form pointer
a step with no successor is a chain break · reported explicitly
chain_integrity_hash = sha256_prefix over the ordered step ids
any modification to any step breaks the integrity hash
claim without evidence_pointer = orphan claim · REJECTED
measurement without tool + tool_version = orphan measurement · REJECTED
measurement without reproducibility_information = orphan measurement · REJECTED

resolver_contract.input: one of · evidence_id · metric_id · measurement_id · bundle_id · architecture_id · profile_id
resolver_contract.output: ProvenanceChain object with resolved steps + fully_resolvable flag + broken_links[]
